response.sql: SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS average_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM telescopes AS t2 WHERE t2.observstation = t.observstation AND t2.equipstatus IS NOT NULL AND t2.equipstatus <> 'Maintenance') GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;
